neighbours.label: Descriptions of nanoscale material structures, particles, and engineered surfaces.
fire: The researchers fabricated conducting nanowires on the silicon substrate.
The enzyme was attached to the surface of a gold nanorod.
Titanium dioxide nanoparticles were embedded in the polymer film.
The optical absorption of semiconductor nanostructures changed after coating.
The device contains a patterned array of carbon nanotubes.
A self-assembled monolayer of molecules covered the gold surface.
The composite contained silver particles only five billionths of a meter across.
The nanocrystals were dispersed throughout the transparent matrix.
quiet: The researchers fabricated conducting wires on the silicon substrate.
The enzyme was attached to the surface of a gold plate.
Titanium dioxide blocks were embedded in the polymer slab.
The optical absorption of semiconductor wafers changed after coating.
The device contains a patterned array of carbon tubes.
A thick layer of paint covered the gold surface.
The composite contained silver particles five millimeters across.
The large crystals were dispersed throughout the transparent matrix.

notes: Target examples concern nanostructures, nanorods, nanoparticles, photonic materials, and monolayers; reverse logit direction promotes nano/particle vocabulary. Controls keep material science but use bulk structures. Two fire sentences describe nanoscale structure without a nano-prefixed word.
